reasoning_content: The user wants me to look for LegendAgent too. Let me also check if there are any .skip files or disabling mechanism:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Search LegendAgent
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -r 'LegendAgent' /opt/areloria --include='*.ts' 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | head -10")
print("Legend:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check WorldTick for any agent calls
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("grep -n 'DeveloperAgent\\|.skip\\|disabled' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20")
print("WorldTick:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
